register_functional_op: register a functional variant of a mutable PyTorch operator using a Library, op name, and OpOverload
construct_functional_impl: construct a functional implementation that clones mutable args, runs the mutable op, and returns cloned values as extra outputs
construct_functionalization_kernel: construct a functionalization kernel that unwraps FunctionalTensorWrapper args, runs the functional op, and propagates updated values
validate_mutable_op: validate that a PyTorch OpOverload is a mutable operator with no annotated returns and no List[Tensor] arguments
functional_schema: generate a functional operator schema string by renaming the signature of a mutable operator
mutable_args: determine which positional arguments of a mutable operator are write aliases for in-place modification
